FINGER SNAPS (source of Snap.wav)

File: 177496_snapper4298.wav
  Original stereo sample (44.1 kHz, 16-bit, 0.558 s) extracted unchanged from the soundfont
  "Finger Snaps" (sample headers 177496__snapper4298L / 177496__snapper4298R, interleaved here as
  left/right). Kept as source art; the game uses the derived mono clip
  game/Assets/_Project/Audio/Sfx/Snap.wav (made by art/audio/derive_finger_snap.py).

Chain of origin
  - Freesound sound 177496 by Snapper4298, part of the pack
    https://freesound.org/people/Snapper4298/packs/11176/
  - Packed as the SF2 soundfont "Finger Snaps" (INAM "Finger Snaps", IENG "Matt Jenkins",
    ICMT "Finger Snaps by Snapper4928 / https://freesound.org/people/Snapper4298/packs/11176/")
  - Shared on Polyphone by "Majenko":
    https://www.polyphone.io/en/soundfonts/unpitched-percussion/529-finger-snaps

License
  The Polyphone page states the license of the soundfont as "public domain".
  The original Freesound license of sound 177496 could NOT be verified (freesound.org was not
  reachable when this was added). Credit given regardless: Snapper4298 (Freesound), soundfont by
  Matt Jenkins / Majenko. Re-check the Freesound page before any commercial release.
